test.name: lifecycle
test.objective: Open, ask the server about itself, ping, close; a closed handle is refused.

test.name: crud
test.objective: A document of each kind of JSON reads back equal; overwrite replaces it, delete removes it.

test.name: keys
test.objective: Keys that need escaping somewhere (slash, percent, query characters, Unicode, 200 bytes) round-trip.

test.name: large
test.objective: A document of the given size round-trips intact.

result.verdict: The engine refused the document as too large

test.name: errors
test.objective: Bad requests fail as invalid and leave the server alone.

test.name: assert_violation
test.objective: Each assertion of tapi_nosql_assert, provoked, reports its stable verdict.

result.verdict: Document violation/probe is not what was expected
Document violation/probe is present but should be absent
Collection violation does not hold the expected number of documents
Collection violation does not hold the expected keys
Counter violation/probe does not hold the expected value
Document violation/probe did not expire in time

test.name: scan
test.objective: Every key of a collection exactly once, in bounded pages.

test.name: paging
test.objective: Any page size gives every key once.

test.name: find
test.objective: Equality queries on top-level fields return exactly the matching documents.

test.name: count
test.objective: The count follows inserts and deletes.

test.name: atomic
test.objective: Conditional writes, counters, lost updates, multi-key writes

test.name: cas
test.objective: Compare-and-set applies with the current version only.

test.name: counter
test.objective: Concurrent increments: none lost; an exact counter returns each value once.

test.name: lost_update
test.objective: Unprotected read-modify-write loses updates (the control); the atomic counter loses none.

test.name: multi
test.objective: Several writes are all applied or none; a failed condition applies nothing.

test.name: ttl
test.objective: An entry is there before its TTL and gone after it.

test.name: ttl_cleared
test.objective: Overwriting without a TTL keeps the entry.

test.name: restart
test.objective: Documents and counters survive a restart of a durable server; a memory-only one loses them.

test.name: timeout
test.objective: A server that stops answering gives a timeout within the deadline; the handle works again after.

test.name: refused
test.objective: Nothing listening: a connection error, at once.

test.name: handles
test.objective: Handles die with the RPC server that held them.

test.name: security
test.objective: Audit with known-bad controls, TLS, authentication, secrets, injection, privileges

test.name: audit
test.objective: The audit reports exactly the planted weaknesses.

test.name: tls
test.objective: The suite's CA is trusted, an unrelated CA is refused, plaintext to a TLS port fails.

test.name: auth
test.objective: A wrong password and no credentials are refused; the right ones work.

test.name: secrets
test.objective: No password in an error, a result, the registry or an audit.

test.name: injection
test.objective: Input concatenated into a query bypasses a login (the control); the same input through tapi_nosql_find() does not.

test.name: privilege
test.objective: The application account cannot administer the server; the administrator can.

test.name: latency
test.objective: Latency percentiles of one client by operation and document size.

test.name: commands
test.objective: Native commands answer as the engine documents.

test.name: equivalence
test.objective: The same documents read back equal from every engine.
